# PERFECT GROUP

PERFECT GROUP is a Retail Apparel and Fashion company. Perfect Group is a model agency that offers training, development, and support in the fashion, luxury, and cosmetics sectors. PERFECT GROUP employs 64 people (-3.0% YoY, -2 people), founded in 1995. Headquartered in Lille, France. Its workforce is distributed across France, Netherlands, and Belgium.

## About

Perfect Group est né d’un désir urgent de repenser l’humain dans le monde actuel du mannequinat.
Nous formons les mannequins pour exalter leur potentiel, pour affiner leur personnalité, pour stimuler leur confiance en eux, en leur style et en leur histoire.
Nous leur fournissons les fondamentaux pour développer leur savoir-faire et leur savoir-être dans ce métier passionnant bien que complexe.
Nos méthodes de travail ont une vision axée sur la bienveillance et l’éthique. Notre métier est de façonner la carrière des mannequins que nous accompagnons.
Sens de l’aisance, confiance et clairvoyance au cœur de tout.

# Perfect Group (Nationwide) Ltd

Perfect Group (Nationwide) Ltd is a Truck Transportation company. Perfect Group is the UK's leading relocation company, offering storage and furniture hire services nationalwide. Perfect Group (Nationwide) Ltd employs 50 people (+13.6% YoY, +6 people), founded in 2007. Headquartered in Horsham, England, United Kingdom, with offices in Walsall, Upper Beeding And Woodmancote Ward, and Upper Beeding.

## About

A company born from helping people relocate, offering the highest service levels and quality across the UK. We are at the top of our game with some of the biggest market leaders and we strive on exceeding every clients needs and expectations.

At Perfect Group we offer three core services in one unique package for the insurance industry. We specialise in Furniture Rental, Relocation and Storage services and work closely with some of the UK’s largest and well known insurance companies.

We offer high quality relocation services, bespoke furniture rental and cost efficient storage solutions, the only company in the UK to offer all three under one roof!

properties.description:
A company born from helping people relocate, offering the highest service levels and quality across the UK. We are at the top of our game with some of the biggest market leaders and we strive on exceeding every clients needs and expectations.

At Perfect Group we offer three core services in one unique package for the insurance industry. We specialise in Furniture Rental, Relocation and Storage services and work closely with some of the UK’s largest and well known insurance companies.

We offer high quality relocation services, bespoke furniture rental and cost efficient storage solutions, the only company in the UK to offer all three under one roof!

Our name says it all.... we have to be 'Perfect'.
